detail.longDescription: A microVM per tenant does not isolate the disk if the thin pool hands out recycled blocks unzeroed. Cloudflare Containers (Sep 24 writeup): Firecracker VMs over dm-thin with skip_block_zeroing, 64 KiB blocks. Write 4 KiB, read /dev/vdc raw, and the other 60 KiB can hold a previous container's data. Researchers found residue on 20 of 22 nodes, SQLite databases included. https:// blog.cloudflare.com/containers -cross-tenant-vulnerability/ # Cybersecurity # CloudSecurity # AIAgents
